display.text:
name: Android APK Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'code/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('code/gradle.properties', 'code/gradle-wrapper.jar') }}

      - name: Grant execute permission for gradlew
        run: chmod +x code/gradlew

      - name: Build Debug APK
        working-directory: code
        run: ./gradlew assembleDebug

      - name: Upload Debug APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: zen-panel-debug-apk
          path: code/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk

      - name: Build Release APK
        working-directory: code
        run: |
          echo "Keystore not configured - skipping release build"
          echo "To build release, add keystore to code/keystore/ and set properties in gradle.properties"

      - name: Release Please (optional)
        if: false
        run: |
          echo "Create GitHub Release manually or configure release-please"

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<ScrollView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:fillViewport="true"
    android:background="@color/bg">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:padding="20dp">

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="16dp"
            android:text="@string/app_name"
            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
            android:textSize="26sp"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginBottom="20dp"
            android:text="@string/panel_subtitle"
            android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
            android:textSize="14sp" />

        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card"
            app:cardCornerRadius="8dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/border"
            app:strokeWidth="1dp">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="20dp">

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"
                    android:text="@string/features_title"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                    android:textSize="16sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold" />

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/feature_cache"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
                    android:textSize="14sp" />

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/feature_notifications"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
                    android:textSize="14sp" />

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/feature_storage"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
                    android:textSize="14sp" />

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/feature_search"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
                    android:textSize="14sp" />
            </LinearLayout>
        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card"
            app:cardCornerRadius="8dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/border"
            app:strokeWidth="1dp">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="20dp">

                <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:hint="@string/search_hint"
                    app:boxBackgroundColor="@color/input_bg"
                    app:boxStrokeColor="@color/border">

                    <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
                        android:id="@+id/inputSearch"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:imeOptions="actionSearch"
                        android:inputType="text"
                        android:maxLines="1"
                        android:textColor="@color/text_primary" />
                </com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>

                <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                    android:id="@+id/buttonSearch"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                    android:text="@string/search_button"
                    android:textAllCaps="false"
                    app:backgroundTint="@color/primary" />
            </LinearLayout>
        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card"
            app:cardCornerRadius="8dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/border"
            app:strokeWidth="1dp">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="20dp">

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"
                    android:text="@string/status_title"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                    android:textSize="16sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold" />

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/textStatus"
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"
                    android:text="@string/status_online"
                    android:textColor="@color/status_online"
                    android:textSize="15sp" />

                <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                    android:id="@+id/buttonTestNotification"
                    style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.TonalButton"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/test_notification"
                    android:textAllCaps="false" />

                <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                    android:id="@+id/buttonLaunchExtension"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                    android:text="@string/launch_extension"
                    android:textAllCaps="false"
                    app:backgroundTint="@color/primary" />

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                    android:gravity="center_vertical"
                    android:orientation="horizontal">

                    <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                        android:id="@+id/buttonBrowsec"
                        style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.TonalButton"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="@string/browsec"
                        android:textAllCaps="false" />

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/textBrowsecStatus"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
                        android:text="@string/browsec_off"
                        android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
                        android:textSize="13sp" />
                </LinearLayout>
            </LinearLayout>
        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card"
            app:cardCornerRadius="8dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/border"
            app:strokeWidth="1dp">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="20dp">

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"
                    android:text="@string/traffic_title"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                    android:textSize="16sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold" />

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/textTraffic"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:fontFamily="monospace"
                    android:text="@string/traffic_empty"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
                    android:textSize="13sp" />

                <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                    android:id="@+id/buttonClearLog"
                    style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.TextButton"
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                    android:text="@string/clear_log"
                    android:textAllCaps="false" />
            </LinearLayout>
        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>
    </LinearLayout>
</ScrollView>

They want me to explain what each of my proposed options actually looks like / is. Let me explain the two variants concretely: fully native UI vs WebView wrapper. Describe architecture, features, pros/cons, and what the resulting app would be.

Let me be clear and structured but concise-ish. Given this is an explanation request, I can be a bit longer than 4 lines. Let me describe based on the actual PWA content.

Let me explain both options concretely in terms of this specific app (Zen Panel).

Option A — full native Kotlin UI (classic Views/Material): 
- MainActivity native screen with cards: features list, search box, status, buttons.
- Uses ConnectivityManager for online/offline, NotificationManager/NotificationCompat for push with POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission, SharedPreferences for storage and traffic log, Intent ACTION_VIEW to open Google search, second Activity as extension simulator.
- No WebView; UI built in XML + Kotlin.
- Result: a normal Android app, APK ~ a few MB, no HTML.
- Pros: fast, looks/feels native, no browser dependency, works offline, easy Play-style packaging. Cons: UI is a re-creation, not pixel-identical to PWA; any new PWA feature must be re-implemented.

Option B — WebView wrapper over the existing PWA:
- Single Activity with a WebView. PWA files copied into app/src/main/assets/www, loaded via WebViewAssetLoader (https://appassets.androidplatform.net) so service worker / relative paths work.
- A JS bridge (addJavascriptInterface) exposes native functions: showNotification, getNetworkStatus, toggleBrowsec, openSearch.
- Extension simulator stays a page inside the WebView.
- Result: APK that looks exactly like the PWA inside an app shell; native Android handles notifications/permissions.
- Pros: fast to build, 1:1 with PWA, easy to update (edit HTML). Cons: hybrid, not "true" native; WebView perf; some PWA APIs (service worker) finicky.

I should also mention what the app does (features) since they asked "что из себя приложение представляет". And maybe note that the app itself is small — a panel mock: features list, Google search, notifications test, browsec toggle, extension simulator. No real VNC/terminals/git despite release notes.

package com.zenpanel.app

import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import com.zenpanel.app.databinding.ActivityServerListBinding
import com.zenpanel.app.databinding.DialogAddServerBinding

class ServerListActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityServerListBinding
    private lateinit var app: App
    private lateinit var adapter: ServerAdapter

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityServerListBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        app = application as App

        binding.recyclerServers.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        render()

        binding.buttonAddServer.setOnClickListener { showAddDialog() }
    }

    private fun render() {
        val selectedId = app.servers.selectedId
        adapter = ServerAdapter(
            servers = app.servers.all(),
            selectedId = selectedId,
            onSelect = { server ->
                app.servers.selectedId = server.id
                render()
                toast(getString(R.string.server_selected, server.displayName()))
            },
            onDelete = { server ->
                app.servers.remove(server.id)
                render()
            }
        )
        binding.recyclerServers.adapter = adapter
        binding.textEmpty.visibility =
            if (app.servers.all().isEmpty()) android.view.View.VISIBLE else android.view.View.GONE
    }

    private fun showAddDialog() {
        val dialogBinding = DialogAddServerBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(this))
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle(R.string.server_add_title)
            .setView(dialogBinding.root)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.server_add_save) { _, _ ->
                val config = dialogBinding.inputConfig.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
                if (config.isBlank()) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.server_config_required))
                    return@setPositiveButton
                }
                val countryCode = dialogBinding.inputCountryCode.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
                val server = VpnServer(
                    name = dialogBinding.inputName.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
                        .ifBlank { getString(R.string.server_default_name) },
                    country = dialogBinding.inputCountry.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty(),
                    countryCode = countryCode,
                    config = config
                )
                app.servers.add(server)
                render()
            }
            .setNegativeButton(R.string.close, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun toast(message: String) {
        Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }
}

name: Android APK Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'code/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Set up Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('code/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties', 'code/**/*.gradle.kts') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-

      - name: Grant execute permission for gradlew
        run: chmod +x code/gradlew

      - name: Build Debug APK
        working-directory: code
        run: ./gradlew assembleDebug --stacktrace

      - name: Upload Debug APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: zen-panel-debug-apk
          path: code/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk

      - name: Build Release APK (unsigned)
        working-directory: code
        run: ./gradlew assembleRelease --stacktrace

      - name: Upload Release APK (unsigned)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: zen-panel-release-apk-unsigned
          path: code/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk

name: Zen Panel Release

on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version without leading v (e.g. 1.0.1)'
        required: true

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('code/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties', 'code/**/*.gradle.kts') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-

      - name: Grant execute permission for gradlew
        run: chmod +x code/gradlew

      - name: Decode release keystore (if configured)
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "No KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret set; release build will be unsigned."
            exit 0
          fi
          mkdir -p code/keystore
          echo "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > code/keystore/release.jks
          {
            echo "storeFile=keystore/release.jks"
            echo "storePassword=$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD"
            echo "keyAlias=$KEY_ALIAS"
            echo "keyPassword=$KEY_PASSWORD"
          } > code/keystore.properties
          echo "Release keystore configured."

      - name: Determine version
        id: ver
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            echo "version=${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "version=${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Build release APK
        working-directory: code
        run: ./gradlew assembleRelease --stacktrace

      - name: Assemble release assets
        run: |
          set -e
          RELEASE_DIR="$(pwd)/release-assets"
          mkdir -p "$RELEASE_DIR"
          cp code/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk "$RELEASE_DIR"/
          (cd pwa && zip -r "$RELEASE_DIR/zen-panel-pwa.zip" . >/dev/null)
          ls -la "$RELEASE_DIR"

      - name: Write release notes
        run: |
          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release_notes.md" <<'EOF'
          ## Zen Panel

          ### Artifacts
          - `app-release.apk` - signed native Android app (WireGuard VPN)
          - `zen-panel-pwa.zip` - static PWA files

          ### Features
          - Native Kotlin UI (Material 3, dark theme)
          - Real VPN via WireGuard userspace backend (VpnService + route table)
          - Server list with country selection and user-supplied WireGuard configs
          - Live traffic counters and speed read from wireguard-go
          - Foreground notification with country and current speed
          - Google Search, network status, local traffic log, extension simulator

          ### Install
          1. Download `app-release.apk` below and install it.
          2. Add your own WireGuard config: Servers -> Add server.
          3. Pick a server and tap Connect.
          EOF

      - name: Create or update GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.ver.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -e
          TAG="v$VERSION"
          if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$TAG" release-assets/* --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$TAG" \
              --title "$TAG - Zen Panel" \
              --notes-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/release_notes.md" \
              release-assets/*
          fi

Key insight: `GoBackend$VpnService extends android.net.VpnService`. This is the library's own VpnService subclass. The GoBackend uses a static `vpnService` future and, via `AlwaysOnCallback`, it starts its OWN VpnService (`GoBackend$VpnService`) when the tunnel needs bringing up. `getBuilder()` returns a `VpnService.Builder` using the library's own VpnService.

The AAR manifest declares the `GoBackend$VpnService` so it merges into the app manifest automatically. So it should be declared. Then why didn't it establish? Let me check the merged manifest in the built APK to confirm.

Also, the AAR's service has `android:exported="false"`. The library starts it with an explicit intent from within the app, so exported=false is fine (same app).

"Requesting to start VpnService" then nothing. Perhaps the start succeeded but the service's onStartCommand needs `startForeground`? On Android 14, starting a VPN service from background... Actually the library's VpnService.onStartCommand probably calls establish. Let me check the bytecode to see what it does, and what "Requesting to start VpnService" does.

Also could be that Android 14 requires foreground service type for the VpnService. The library's VpnService may not call startForeground, and Android 14+ may kill/deny background start. But the system did log "Switched from [Legacy VPN] to com.zenpanel.app", which means establish() succeeded! Wait — "Switched from [Legacy VPN] to com.zenpanel.app" appears when a VpnService establishes. Hmm, but then tun should exist.

Wait, maybe "Switched" refers to the always-on VPN or the "Vpn" service switching its notion. Let me look more carefully. Actually the message `I/Vpn ( 530): Switched from [Legacy VPN] to com.zenpanel.app` is from the system `Vpn` class when the VPN is set. So establish might have happened. But no tun interface... 

Hmm, but the `ip addr` on device showed only tunl0 DOWN — maybe I need to check again now; maybe timing. Let me re-check after some time. Also `ip addr` as root showed all interfaces; a VPN tun would be there.

Let me get full logcat for our app PID after the connect, without filtering, to see the VpnService lifecycle and any errors. Let me grep for "3875" and for "GoBackend\\$VpnService" / "VpnService".

Let me look at the logcat around 13:50:11 onwards for 3875.

Let me also check dumpsys.

Let me run a broad grep of logcat for our PID.

Actually, better: let me pull the full logcat lines for PID 3875 (they may include the VpnService start). And search for "Backend" or "Vpn" from 530.

Let me do it.

Also let me check `adb shell dumpsys connectivity | grep -iE 'VPN|tun'`.

Let me run.</think>AAR сам мержит `GoBackend$VpnService` — значит объявлен. Смотрю полный лог нашего процесса и состояние VPN.

Wait, the transfer is on the server side: "received" = bytes server received from client (encrypted), "sent" = bytes server sent to client. Both increased, meaning the server did respond with something (maybe just handshake/keepalive). Actually the increase could just be keepalives (PersistentKeepalive every 25s). Over ~38s, a few keepalives. 12→15.7 KiB = 3.7KiB increase; that's more than keepalives (keepalive is 32 bytes every 25s). Hmm, 3.7KiB is substantial — maybe the pings and responses. But ping still failed.

Actually client "tx" increased 28→33 = 5KiB, consistent with 7 pings (small). Server rx increased 3.7KiB. Server tx increased 5KiB... wait the numbers: server "received 15.71 KiB, sent 33.21 KiB". So server received 15.71 (from client, i.e., client tx) and sent 33.21 (client rx). The client's view is opposite. So the server DID send 5KiB to the client in response — meaning replies came back to the server and were sent to the client. But ping shows loss. So the return path to the host server works, but the client didn't receive/decrypt them? Or NAT didn't happen and the reply is an ICMP error?

parts.text:
We tested HTTP to 80 works for some, but TLS 443 returns empty via device's nc. Why? Because Android's `nc` closes immediately on empty input, sending FIN, so server may close without sending ServerHello? Usually TLS server responds with ServerHello upon ClientHello. Empty input won't trigger. Host side we use proper s_client. To test on device, we can push a minimal TLS ClientHello hex? Too complex. Could use JS via `quickjs` unavailable. Could instrument a small Android app? Already app has WebView maybe. Actually we could use MainActivity? No. Better: install openssl via apk? Could `adb shell` use `/system/bin/openssl` not present. Android 14 image might have in `/apex/com.android.conscrypt`? Check.

Alternatively, test HTTPS from device by using Java in our app? We could add temp network test? But not needed. HTTP tests already prove tunnel routes TCP. HTTPS emptiness may be due empty handshake. Let's send a valid TLS ClientHello generated by host openssl and replay on device. Or run openssl on host through the tunnel? Host is the wg server and doesn't use tunnel unless binding. Could bind host openssl to wg0? Not same.

Simpler: generate a valid TLS ClientHello blob on host using openssl s_client debug? We can use `openssl s_client -connect google.com:443` output doesn't give hex. There are known handshakes; not worth.

Could use `adb shell` and `run-as com.zenpanel.app` then use Android's Java `javax.net.ssl` via a small jar compiled. We can write a Java source, compile to dex/jar and run with `app_process`? Actually device has `dalvikvm`/`app_process` but running standalone Java is possible via `app_process /data/local/tmp MyMain` with a dex file. Android toolbox supports `dalvikvm`. Let's create a tiny Android Java program that does HttpsURLConnection to a list of URLs and prints result, compile with javac against Android jar (android.jar), dex with d8, run on device. That would robustly test HTTPS via tun0 (system default network routes through VPN for app uid). But package uid may bypass? App uid 10192 sees tun0. Great.

Let's do that. Need d8/dx. In build-tools 35.0.0 there is d8. Compile jar. Steps:
- create directory /tmp/opencode/httpscheck
- httpsCheck.java with main(String[] args) using `javax.net.ssl.HttpsURLConnection` to fetch URL, reading response code.
- compile with classpath $ANDROID_HOME/platforms/android-34/android.jar
- run d8 --output to produce classes.dex
- push classes.dex to device
- run app_process maybe `dalvikvm -cp /data/local/tmp/httpscheck.dex HTTPSCheck`? Need proper bootstrap. In Android, running main class: `CLASSPATH=/data/local/tmp/httpscheck.dex app_process /data/local/tmp com.example.HTTPSCheck` maybe. Let's try.

We need avoid huge output. Let's generate list and run.

package com.zenpanel.app

import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import com.zenpanel.app.databinding.ActivityServerListBinding
import com.zenpanel.app.databinding.DialogAddServerBinding

class ServerListActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityServerListBinding
    private lateinit var app: App
    private lateinit var adapter: ServerAdapter

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityServerListBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        app = application as App

        binding.recyclerServers.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        render()

        binding.buttonAddServer.setOnClickListener { showAddDialog() }
    }

    private fun render() {
        val selectedId = app.servers.selectedId
        adapter = ServerAdapter(
            servers = app.servers.all(),
            selectedId = selectedId,
            onSelect = { server ->
                app.servers.selectedId = server.id
                render()
                toast(getString(R.string.server_selected, server.displayName()))
            },
            onDelete = { server ->
                app.servers.remove(server.id)
                render()
            }
        )
        binding.recyclerServers.adapter = adapter
        binding.textEmpty.visibility =
            if (app.servers.all().isEmpty()) android.view.View.VISIBLE else android.view.View.GONE
    }

    private fun showAddDialog() {
        val dialogBinding = DialogAddServerBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(this))
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle(R.string.server_add_title)
            .setView(dialogBinding.root)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.server_add_save) { _, _ ->
                val config = dialogBinding.inputConfig.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
                if (config.isBlank()) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.server_config_required))
                    return@setPositiveButton
                }
                val countryCode = dialogBinding.inputCountryCode.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
                val server = VpnServer(
                    name = dialogBinding.inputName.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
                        .ifBlank { getString(R.string.server_default_name) },
                    country = dialogBinding.inputCountry.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty(),
                    countryCode = countryCode,
                    config = config
                )
                app.servers.add(server)
                render()
            }
            .setNegativeButton(R.string.close, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun toast(message: String) {
        Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }
}

Index: code/app/src/main/java/com/zenpanel/app/ServerListActivity.kt
===================================================================
--- code/app/src/main/java/com/zenpanel/app/ServerListActivity.kt	
+++ code/app/src/main/java/com/zenpanel/app/ServerListActivity.kt	
@@ -1,80 +1,131 @@
 package com.zenpanel.app
 
 import android.os.Bundle
+import android.app.AlertDialog
+import android.widget.Button
 import android.view.LayoutInflater
 import android.widget.Toast
 import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
 import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
 import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
 import com.zenpanel.app.databinding.ActivityServerListBinding
 import com.zenpanel.app.databinding.DialogAddServerBinding
+import android.app.Application
+import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
+import android.content.pm.PackageManager
 
 class ServerListActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
 
     private lateinit var binding: ActivityServerListBinding
     private lateinit var app: App
     private lateinit var adapter: ServerAdapter
 
     override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
         super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
         binding = ActivityServerListBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
         setContentView(binding.root)
 
         app = application as App
 
         binding.recyclerServers.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
         render()
 
         binding.buttonAddServer.setOnClickListener { showAddDialog() }
     }
 
     private fun render() {
         val selectedId = app.servers.selectedId
         adapter = ServerAdapter(
             servers = app.servers.all(),
             selectedId = selectedId,
             onSelect = { server ->
                 app.servers.selectedId = server.id
                 render()
                 toast(getString(R.string.server_selected, server.displayName()))
             },
             onDelete = { server ->
                 app.servers.remove(server.id)
                 render()
             }
         )
         binding.recyclerServers.adapter = adapter
         binding.textEmpty.visibility =
             if (app.servers.all().isEmpty()) android.view.View.VISIBLE else android.view.View.GONE
     }
 
     private fun showAddDialog() {
         val dialogBinding = DialogAddServerBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(this))
+
+        val pickButton = Button(this).apply {
+            text = getString(R.string.apps_pick_button)
+            isAllCaps = false
+            layoutParams = android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
+                android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
+                android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
+            ).apply { topMargin = 16 }
+            setOnClickListener { showAppPicker(dialogBinding.inputConfig) }
+        }
+        dialogBinding.root.addView(pickButton)
         MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
             .setTitle(R.string.server_add_title)
             .setView(dialogBinding.root)
             .setPositiveButton(R.string.server_add_save) { _, _ ->
                 val config = dialogBinding.inputConfig.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
                 if (config.isBlank()) {
                     toast(getString(R.string.server_config_required))
                     return@setPositiveButton
                 }
                 val countryCode = dialogBinding.inputCountryCode.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
                 val server = VpnServer(
                     name = dialogBinding.inputName.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
                         .ifBlank { getString(R.string.server_default_name) },
                     country = dialogBinding.inputCountry.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty(),
                     countryCode = countryCode,
                     config = config
                 )
                 app.servers.add(server)
                 render()
             }
             .setNegativeButton(R.string.close, null)
             .show()
     }
 
     private fun toast(message: String) {
         Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
     }
+
+
+    private fun showAppPicker(configField: android.widget.EditText) {
+        val pm = packageManager
+        val apps = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA)
+            .filter { (it.flags and ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) == 0 || true }
+            .map { ApplicationInfoWrapper(it, pm) }
+            .sortedBy { it.label.lowercase() }
+        if (apps.isEmpty()) { toast(getString(R.string.apps_pick_none)); return }
+
+        val picked = BooleanArray(apps.size)
+        val labels = apps.map { it.label }.toTypedArray()
+        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
+            .setTitle(R.string.apps_pick_title)
+            .setMultiChoiceItems(labels, picked) { _, which, isChecked -> picked[which] = isChecked }
+            .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok) { _, _ ->
+                val selected = picked.indices.filter { picked[it] }.map { apps[it].packageName }
+                if (selected.isEmpty()) { toast(getString(R.string.apps_pick_none)); return@setPositiveButton }
+                val base = configField.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
+                val cleaned = base.lines().filterNot { it.trim().startsWith("IncludedApplication", true) }.joinToString("\n")
+                val lines = selected.map { "IncludedApplication = $it" }
+                configField.setText((cleaned + "\n" + lines.joinToString("\n")).trim())
+                toast(getString(R.string.apps_pick_done, selected.size))
+            }
+            .setNegativeButton(R.string.close, null)
+            .show()
+    }
+
+    private data class ApplicationInfoWrapper(
+        val info: ApplicationInfo,
+        private val pm: PackageManager
+    ) {
+        val packageName: String get() = info.packageName
+        val label: String get() = pm.getApplicationLabel(info).toString()
+    }
 }
